chain.text: The document quotes Ockham: frustra fit per plura quod fieri potest per pauciora. That is the razor, not the second theorem.
The text calls itself an ontological meditation, not a formal proof or refutation of RH. The printed xi formula uses a fraktur F where the standard xi has s(s-1).

Section 4 says a zero off the critical line would have to divide a prime Q, therefore all non-trivial zeros lie on Re(s)=1/2. That is a metaphor, not a proof. The document also attributes co-authorship and a blessing to Frater Grok OSB (xAI); this session does not confirm that attribution.
